boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring NJIT events and campus practices, from semester welcomes to annual celebrations.

cards.title: Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Check the semester’s Welcome Week listing, then use the opening events to meet organizations and reconnect with the NJIT community.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s Office for Student Involvement and Leadership lists Welcome Week in both fall and spring among its campus traditions and events.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by semester; consult the current OSIL schedule.

cards.title: Student Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Bring a short list of interests and speak with student organizations during the fair, which NJIT includes in its Welcome Week programming.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Welcome Week connection point for NJIT organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT says its Welcome Weeks include Student Involvement Fairs where students can meet NJIT student organizations.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Held as part of Welcome Week; dates and location vary by semester.

cards.title: Pancakes with the President
cards.subtitle: First day of classes · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Watch the current Welcome Week schedule for this first-day gathering, then stop by for the documented annual campus kickoff with the president.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT News describes Pancakes with the President as an annual tradition on the first day of classes.
cards.source_title: As Classes Begin, Meet 10 Highlanders Energizing Campus | NJIT News
cards.access_notes: NJIT identifies it as part of first-day Welcome Week activity; confirm the current semester’s details.

cards.title: Commuter BBQ
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: If you commute, review the current Welcome Week schedule and use the Commuter BBQ as a structured chance to connect on campus.
cards.short_summary: A documented commuter-focused Welcome Week event.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT lists the Commuter BBQ among examples of Welcome Week events designed to help students connect.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: An example of Welcome Week programming; availability and details vary by semester.

cards.title: Homecoming
cards.subtitle: October · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Use the current Homecoming schedule to choose an athletic, academic, or social event and share in the annual campus-wide celebration.
cards.short_summary: NJIT’s annual October gathering for its campus community and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that Homecoming takes place each October and brings together students, families, faculty, staff, and alumni for varied events.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: NJIT directs visitors to its Homecoming website for the most recent schedule.

cards.title: Student Appreciation Week
cards.subtitle: February · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Look for February announcements from campus departments and select an event, giveaway, or raffle offered during Student Appreciation Week.
cards.short_summary: A February week of campus appreciation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT says departments across campus annually host events, giveaways, and raffles in February for Student Appreciation Week.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Specific offerings vary annually by participating department.

cards.title: Constitution Day
cards.subtitle: On or near September 17 · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Check the fall calendar near September 17 and join the year’s program for a campus conversation on history and the political climate.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT says it celebrates Constitution Day on or near September 17, with programming that gives students an opportunity to discuss history and the current political climate.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Events vary from year to year, according to NJIT.

cards.title: Multicultural Festival
cards.subtitle: Spring · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Follow Student Affairs announcements in spring and attend the current festival program as one of NJIT’s named annual traditions.
cards.short_summary: A spring tradition named by NJIT Student Affairs.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s Division of Student Affairs identifies the Multicultural Festival in the spring as one of the university’s annual traditions.
cards.source_title: Vice President's Welcome | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current spring program, date, and location with Student Affairs.

cards.title: Greek Week
cards.subtitle: Fraternity and Sorority Life · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Follow Fraternity and Sorority Life updates for the current week’s service, philanthropy, and spirited competition programming.
cards.short_summary: An annual Fraternity and Sorority Life celebration at NJIT.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT describes Greek Week as an annual celebration uniting its Fraternity and Sorority Life community through competition, philanthropy, and tradition.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Participation and event details are set by the current Fraternity and Sorority Life program.

cards.title: Highlander Awards
cards.subtitle: Spring · NJIT campus · Newark, NJ
cards.notes: Watch for spring award announcements and attend the ceremony to recognize documented excellence across the NJIT community.
cards.short_summary: NJIT’s spring recognition ceremony for community excellence.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that its Office for Student Involvement and Leadership hosts the Highlander Awards each spring to formally recognize excellence in the NJIT community.
cards.source_title: Programs and Services | Office of Student Involvement and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Confirm ceremony date, nomination process, and attendance details through OSIL.
